description:
requireUser in router.tsx destructures { data } and redirects on anything falsy, so a dropped connection mid-workout is indistinguishable from being signed out. Every in-app navigation re-runs this live network check, which means a flaky gym connection can eject you from a session in progress.

Distinguish "no session" from "request failed", keep the user where they are on a failure, and add a router error boundary so the failure is visible rather than a silent bounce to the sign-in screen.
title: Survive a failed auth check instead of redirecting to sign-in
